Greedy: no spec arm beats off with both slots busy — dual-agent 26.3(off)/25.5(A)/23.0(B), dual-mem 25.0/23.8/22.4. Per the plan rule the best of A/B is A (dual-agent fg 25.5 vs B 23.0), so the remaining prod run is A. Updated m1-notes.md (§10 mmproj confirmed, §11 off-prod verified, §12 state/decision) and noted off arms' missing draft fields are by design in each notes.txt. Next: run A-prod, then decide (deploy only if A-prod's combined dual throughput beats off-prod 47.8 tok/s).
